quest.title: Autonomous Mechanical Energy Source: Live Sample
quest.description: The calibration work on Pursina's Spikes went quite smoothly indeed. Now it's time to see them in action.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Thanks to the trial data you gathered, the final calibrations to our Pursina's Spikes have been completed.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Now, I can call myself reasonably confident that they will perform as expected.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: As long as we place the Spikes in locations that our anomalous model frequents, we should be able to control its power supply.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: As long as we can activate the Spikes fully, that machine should be unable to initiate its self-repair protocols.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: No, no, don't thank me, thank those who came before us and the wisdom that they left behind.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: If we did not have that knowledge as our guide, we wouldn't have been able to come up with a way to take that anomalous Ruin Grader down.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: All we have done up till now relies on such guiding knowledge, and it is knowledge that is the most valuable resource in the world.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It's normal to not comprehend this. After all, you have not yet been edified by the supreme wisdom.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: ...Hah, look how far I've gone on this tangent. Guess I was too excited at having been able to repair these Pursina's Spikes.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, now comes the final phase of our preparations. And by that, I mean that we must place these Spikes on Tsurumi Island.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: ...I'm afraid that I shan't be able to help you with that.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: According to Inazuma's local laws, people who lack Residence Permits like myself cannot move about freely. As such, this task is up to you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Thank you. I'd suggest that you not act immediately after placing the Spikes. Instead, quickly check to see if everything is functioning normally, and then check back in with me.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I think we can afford to be a bit more careful for your safety's sake.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, not exactly, I think. I would much prefer hailing the knowledge that our predecessors left behind for us to use.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did the Spikes function as expected?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Good, good, that's good. I only hope that it won't break down later, either.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Well then. All we need is for the anomalous Ruin Grader to near the Spikes when we activate them, and it should become cut off from its power supply.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: This time, you should be able to defeat it for good, so have at it!

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I have faith in your abilities.
